sub: The slow Saturday, off-duty and easy.
note: Off-duty ease that still reads expensive. A chunky ivory wool knit over straight-leg Levi's 501s, grounded by grey suede Gazelles and a roomy black Longchamp tote — relaxed shapes kept in a quiet oat, indigo and grey palette. The textured wool adds warmth against the clean line of the denim, while the retro trainer keeps the whole thing young and easy. Made for the slow Saturday: the coffee run, the market, the long walk home.

pieces.name: Ivory Wool Textured Crew-Neck Sweater

note: A camel wool coat worn long over a gathered-side black knit dress — warm neutral against deep ink, the quietest kind of statement. The double-faced wool holds its line without lining bulk, while the jersey dress moves with you. Black ankle boots ground it for the commute and keep it sharp enough for dinner after. One palette, two textures, no effort showing.

sub: The evening, in a single column of black.
note: The evening, distilled to a single line. The draped jersey moves as you do and needs no jewellery to finish it. For dinner, a launch, or a night that asks for less, done better.
